name: premium-explorer
description: Tell your projects apart at a glance: color-code folders in the Explorer. Git repos get a color automatically, or style any folder yourself.

premiumExplorer.enabled.description: Color folders that contain a Git repository.

premiumExplorer.rules.markdownDescription:
Path-scoped coloring rules, evaluated by path specificity (a deeper rule wins). With no rules, nothing is colored.

- `git`: every Git repository under `path` is colored automatically, each from `premiumExplorer.palette`.
- `manual` (used when `engine` is omitted): the folder at `path` **and everything inside it** is styled by this rule's layer settings, over a base of `premiumExplorer.defaultColor`.

Each folder is painted with independent layers — **background**, **edge** bar, **pill**, **text** and **watermark** watermark — set globally via `premiumExplorer.root*`/`premiumExplorer.inner*` and overridable per rule with the same `root*`/`inner*` keys (a `*Color` left empty falls back to the folder base).

Paths may be workspace-relative (`.`, `./projects`) or absolute.

```jsonc
"premiumExplorer.rules": [
  { "path": ".", "engine": "git" },
  { "path": "./notes", "rootBackgroundColor": "#00b8ff", "rootPill": "solid",
    "rootTextStyle": "bold", "innerBackgroundStyle": "none" },
  { "path": "./scratch" }
]
```

enumDescriptions: Auto-color every Git repository found under this path, each from `premiumExplorer.palette`.
Style this folder and everything inside it with the layer settings on this rule.
engine.markdownDescription: How this path is colored. Defaults to `manual` if omitted. (`default` is still accepted as an old name for `manual`.)

enumDescriptions: No full-row fill — bare VS Code styling.
Fill the whole row with the background color.
Reuse whatever the nearest **enclosing** colored folder paints on its inner rows (blend into the parent instead of punching a hole in it).
rootBackgroundStyle.markdownDescription: **Background** layer for the repo root row. `none` = not painted, `solid` = this rule's color, `inherit` = the enclosing colored folder's inner look.

rootBackgroundColor.markdownDescription: Color of the full-row fill for the repo root row. Empty falls back to `#premiumExplorer.defaultColor#` for a `manual` rule, or the repo's hashed palette color for a `git` rule.

rootBackgroundOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the background fill for the repo root row.

enumDescriptions: No edge bar — bare VS Code styling.
Draw a colored bar on the left edge of the row.
Reuse whatever the nearest **enclosing** colored folder paints on its inner rows (blend into the parent instead of punching a hole in it).
rootEdge.markdownDescription: **Edge** layer for the repo root row. `none` = not painted, `solid` = this rule's color, `inherit` = the enclosing colored folder's inner look.

rootEdgeColor.markdownDescription: Color of the left edge bar for the repo root row. Empty falls back to `#premiumExplorer.defaultColor#` for a `manual` rule, or the repo's hashed palette color for a `git` rule.

rootEdgeOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the edge bar for the repo root row.

enumDescriptions: No pill — bare VS Code styling.
Draw a rounded background behind just the label text.
Reuse whatever the nearest **enclosing** colored folder paints on its inner rows (blend into the parent instead of punching a hole in it).
rootPill.markdownDescription: **Pill** layer for the repo root row. `none` = not painted, `solid` = this rule's color, `inherit` = the enclosing colored folder's inner look.

rootPillColor.markdownDescription: Color of the pill behind the label for the repo root row. Empty falls back to `#premiumExplorer.defaultColor#` for a `manual` rule, or the repo's hashed palette color for a `git` rule.

rootPillOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the pill for the repo root row.

rootPillRadius.markdownDescription: Corner radius (px) of the pill for the repo root row.

rootTextStyle.markdownDescription: **Text** weight/style for the repo root row's label.
enumDescriptions: No weight/style change — the theme decides.
Bold label.
Italic label.
Bold + italic label.

rootTextColor.markdownDescription: Label text color for the repo root row. Empty = leave it to the theme.

Bold label.
Italic label.
Bold + italic label.

innerTextColor.markdownDescription: Label text color for the inner rows (files/folders inside). Empty = leave it to the theme.

rootEdgeColors.markdownDescription: Explicit colour **sequence** for the repo root row's edge bar, drawn as 45° stripes. Empty = auto-derived from the folder's hash (see `#premiumExplorer.edgeColorCount#`).

rootEdgeWidth.markdownDescription: Width in px of the repo root row's edge bar.

rootEdgeStripeSize.markdownDescription: Thickness in px of one diagonal stripe band on the repo root row's edge bar.

enumDescriptions: No watermark — bare VS Code styling.
Scatter the folder's watermark faintly behind the row.
Reuse whatever the nearest **enclosing** colored folder paints on its inner rows.
rootWatermarkStyle.markdownDescription: **Watermark** layer for the repo root row: artwork scattered faintly behind the row (the rule's `backgroundWatermark`, else the folder name's initial).

rootWatermarkColor.markdownDescription: Watermark color for the repo root row. Empty = **the row's own fill colour**, stepped just clear of the row so the pattern reads as texture in the background rather than a colour laid over it — how far is `rootWatermarkContrast`. Set `original` to keep a custom SVG's own colors instead of flattening it to one shade.

rootWatermarkContrast.markdownDescription: How far the watermark on the repo root row steps off the fill colour it inherits, as a fraction of the distance to white (over a dark row) or black (over a light one). The step is what lifts the pattern clear of the row it paints on; keep it small so the watermarks stay a shade of the background rather than a colour of their own. Ignored once `rootWatermarkColor` pins a color. 0 = the fill colour exactly, 0.5 = a washed-out mark.

enumDescriptions: Both. The clearing does the general work and breaks the pattern up so no two folders look alike; the text cover then catches whatever a long name still runs into, which a clearing fixed to the canvas cannot know about.
Only the text cover: every copy a row's own text reaches is dimmed whole — never clipped half way — and the rest of the scatter is left even.
Only the baked clearing: fewer and fainter copies down the middle of the canvas where names run, full strength out in the margins. Costs nothing at paint time and never touches the row's colour.
rootWatermarkDimStyle.markdownDescription: How the watermark on the repo root row gets out of the way of what you are reading.

rootWatermarkDim.markdownDescription: How far the watermark is dimmed on the repo root row, as a fraction. It sets the strength of whichever dimming `rootWatermarkDimStyle` selects: how much thinner and fainter the scatter gets down the middle of the canvas, and how far a copy the row's text runs into is taken back. `0` turns dimming off entirely.

rootWatermarkOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the repo root row's watermark. Keep it low — it should read as texture, not content.

rootWatermarkSize.markdownDescription: Watermark size in px for the repo root row — the average, since individual copies vary by `rootWatermarkVariation`. The canvas is 512px, so this can go a lot larger than a text watermark normally would.

innerEdgeColors.markdownDescription: Explicit colour **sequence** for the inner rows (files/folders inside)'s edge bar, drawn as 45° stripes. Empty = auto-derived from the folder's hash (see `#premiumExplorer.edgeColorCount#`).

innerEdgeWidth.markdownDescription: Width in px of the inner rows (files/folders inside)'s edge bar.

innerEdgeStripeSize.markdownDescription: Thickness in px of one diagonal stripe band on the inner rows (files/folders inside)'s edge bar.

It sets the strength of whichever dimming `innerWatermarkDimStyle` selects: how much thinner and fainter the scatter gets down the middle of the canvas, and how far a copy the row's text runs into is taken back. `0` turns dimming off entirely.

innerWatermarkOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the inner rows (files/folders inside)'s watermark. Keep it low — it should read as texture, not content.

innerWatermarkSize.markdownDescription: Watermark size in px for the rows inside a colored folder — the average, since individual copies vary by `innerWatermarkVariation`. The canvas is 512px, so this can go a lot larger than a text watermark normally would.

rootWatermarkCanvas.markdownDescription: Size in px of the square canvas the repo root row watermark is drawn on. At the default 512 it is wider than any sidebar and ~23 rows tall, so the background reads as one unique composition instead of a repeating tile. Smaller values start to look like wallpaper.

rootWatermarkDensity.markdownDescription: Watermarks per 100x100px of canvas for the repo root row. Higher packs them tighter; the count scales with `rootWatermarkCanvas` so resizing the canvas keeps the same look.

rootWatermarkVariation.markdownDescription: 0-1 — how much the repo root row watermarks vary in size, brightness and position. 0 is a uniform grid; tilt is separate, see `rootWatermarkRotation`.

innerWatermarkCanvas.markdownDescription: Size in px of the square canvas the rows inside a colored folder watermark is drawn on. At the default 512 it is wider than any sidebar and ~23 rows tall, so the background reads as one unique composition instead of a repeating tile. Smaller values start to look like wallpaper.

innerWatermarkDensity.markdownDescription: Watermarks per 100x100px of canvas for the rows inside a colored folder. Higher packs them tighter; the count scales with `innerWatermarkCanvas` so resizing the canvas keeps the same look.

innerWatermarkVariation.markdownDescription: 0-1 — how much the rows inside a colored folder watermarks vary in size, brightness and position. 0 is a uniform grid; tilt is separate, see `innerWatermarkRotation`.

backgroundWatermark.markdownDescription: Character/emoji, or a path to an `.svg` file, tiled faintly behind the rows — e.g. `🐳`, `⚙`, `./.vscode/whale.svg`, `~/icons/aws.svg`. Relative paths resolve against the folder itself, then each workspace root. Inline `<svg>` markup and `data:image/svg+xml` URIs also work. Overrides `premiumExplorer.backgroundWatermark` for this rule.

rootWatermarkRotation.markdownDescription: Max tilt in degrees for the repo root row watermarks; each copy is rotated somewhere within +/- this. Tilt is what keeps repeated copies of one mark from reading as a grid, so it stays useful even at `rootWatermarkVariation: 0`. 180 spins them any which way.

innerWatermarkRotation.markdownDescription: Max tilt in degrees for the rows inside a colored folder watermarks; each copy is rotated somewhere within +/- this. Tilt is what keeps repeated copies of one mark from reading as a grid, so it stays useful even at `innerWatermarkVariation: 0`. 180 spins them any which way.

rootWatermarkDimWidth.markdownDescription: The width in px of that clearing on the repo root row. It is baked into the canvas, so resizing the Explorer cannot change how any watermark is drawn.

rootWatermarkDimHeight.markdownDescription: The height in px of the clearing on the repo root row — how far apart its points sit down the canvas. Capped at ``rootWatermarkCanvas``, and the shape tapers to a point at top and bottom so it tiles seamlessly.

innerWatermarkDimWidth.markdownDescription: The width in px of that clearing on the rows inside a colored folder. It is baked into the canvas, so resizing the Explorer cannot change how any watermark is drawn.

innerWatermarkDimHeight.markdownDescription: The height in px of the clearing on the rows inside a colored folder — how far apart its points sit down the canvas. Capped at ``innerWatermarkCanvas``, and the shape tapers to a point at top and bottom so it tiles seamlessly.

enumDescriptions: Hash the folder name, so folders with the same name share a color.
Hash the full folder path, so every folder gets an independent color.
premiumExplorer.colorBy.description: What to hash when picking an automatic color for a Git repository folder.

premiumExplorer.badge.markdownDescription: Optional badge (max 2 characters) shown next to Git repository folders, e.g. `●`. Leave empty to color the label only.

premiumExplorer.palette.markdownDescription: Colors (hex) used to auto-assign a per-repo color by hashing its name/path. Up to 16 entries. Fewer entries = fewer distinct colors.

premiumExplorer.defaultColor.markdownDescription: Base color for `manual` rules — the fallback every layer uses when its own `*Color` is empty. `git` rules ignore it and hash each repo against `#premiumExplorer.palette#` instead.

enumDescriptions: The color the row already shows, lifted a step away from the theme.
The color that row is filled with, at full strength.

premiumExplorer.selectedBackgroundColor.markdownDescription:
Background of the selected/focused Explorer row inside a colored folder.

- `shift` — whatever the row already shows, lifted a step (`#premiumExplorer.selectedShift#`), so the selection reads as *this row, marked* instead of a foreign highlight. Carries its own strength, so `#premiumExplorer.selectedOpacity#` does not apply: compositing a shift back over the color it was measured from would cancel it out.
- `invert` — the color that row is filled with (its `*BackgroundColor`, else the folder base), at `#premiumExplorer.selectedOpacity#`.
- A hex such as `#ffffff`, at `#premiumExplorer.selectedOpacity#`.

Applies only when `background` is listed in `#premiumExplorer.selectedOverrides#`.

premiumExplorer.selectedShift.markdownDescription: How far `shift` lifts the selected row off the color it already shows, as a fraction of the distance to white on a dark theme (black on a light one). `0.05` is barely there; `0.12` reads clearly without losing the folder's color; `0.4` is close to a plain highlight. Only used when `#premiumExplorer.selectedBackgroundColor#` is `shift`; the Explorer shifts by less than half this while it is unfocused.

premiumExplorer.selectedTextColor.markdownDescription: Text color of the selected/focused row. `auto` = black or white chosen for contrast, or a hex.

premiumExplorer.selectedOpacity.markdownDescription: Opacity of the selected row background (1 = solid).

premiumExplorer.selectedBold.markdownDescription: Make the selected/focused row’s label bold.

premiumExplorer.selectedBorder.markdownDescription: Border (focus ring) drawn around the selected row **while the Explorer is focused**. `none` = no border, `auto` = the theme’s focus-outline color, or a hex.

premiumExplorer.selectedInactiveDarken.markdownDescription: How much darker the selected row becomes when the Explorer is **not** focused (0 = same color, 1 = black). The border is also dropped while unfocused, mirroring VS Code’s inactive selection.

premiumExplorer.backgroundWatermark.markdownDescription: Default watermark artwork for every colored folder. Character/emoji, or a path to an `.svg` file, tiled faintly behind the rows — e.g. `🐳`, `⚙`, `./.vscode/whale.svg`, `~/icons/aws.svg`. Relative paths resolve against the folder itself, then each workspace root. Inline `<svg>` markup and `data:image/svg+xml` URIs also work. Empty = each folder uses the first letter of its own name. Whether it is *drawn* is up to `rootWatermarkStyle` / `innerWatermarkStyle`.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkCanvas.markdownDescription: Size in px of the square canvas the repo root row watermark is drawn on. At the default 512 it is wider than any sidebar and ~23 rows tall, so the background reads as one unique composition instead of a repeating tile. Smaller values start to look like wallpaper.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkDensity.markdownDescription: Watermarks per 100x100px of canvas for the repo root row. Higher packs them tighter; the count scales with `rootWatermarkCanvas` so resizing the canvas keeps the same look.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkVariation.markdownDescription: 0-1 — how much the repo root row watermarks vary in size, brightness and position. 0 is a uniform grid; tilt is separate, see `rootWatermarkRotation`.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkRotation.markdownDescription: Max tilt in degrees for the repo root row watermarks; each copy is rotated somewhere within +/- this. Tilt is what keeps repeated copies of one mark from reading as a grid, so it stays useful even at `rootWatermarkVariation: 0`. 180 spins them any which way.

premiumExplorer.innerWatermarkRotation.markdownDescription: Max tilt in degrees for the rows inside a colored folder watermarks; each copy is rotated somewhere within +/- this. Tilt is what keeps repeated copies of one mark from reading as a grid, so it stays useful even at `innerWatermarkVariation: 0`. 180 spins them any which way.

enumDescriptions: Fill the row with `selectedBackgroundColor`.
Re-tint the watermark to `selectedWatermarkColor`.
Paint the label with `selectedTextColor`.
Fill the pill behind the label with the selection color.

premiumExplorer.selectedOverrides.markdownDescription:
Which styles the selection color takes over. **Only what is listed changes on a selected row** — everything else keeps painting exactly as it does unselected.

- `["background"]` — only the row fill turns the selection color; the watermark and label are untouched.
- `[]` — selection changes nothing but the focus ring (`selectedBorder`, which is always its own setting).
- Default `["background", "watermarks", "text-color"]` — the row is filled, the watermark is re-tinted to match, and the label takes `selectedTextColor`.

The **edge bar is never taken over**: it is the one mark that still says which folder a selected or renaming row belongs to, so it always keeps its own colours.

`pills` is out of the default: a pill the selection has not taken over keeps its own fill and gains a traced edge, so an `invert` highlight painting the row in the pill color does not swallow it.

premiumExplorer.selectedWatermarkColor.markdownDescription:
Watermark color on a selected row, when `watermarks` is in `#premiumExplorer.selectedOverrides#`.

- `auto` (default) — a shade just off the selection color: darker when the selection is light, lighter when it is dark. How far off is `#premiumExplorer.selectedWatermarkContrast#`.
- A hex — that exact color, whatever the selection is.

premiumExplorer.selectedWatermarkContras.markdownDescription:
How far the `auto` selected watermark sits off the color the row is actually painted, as a fraction of the distance to black or white. Only used when `#premiumExplorer.selectedWatermarkColor#` is `auto` and `watermarks` is in `#premiumExplorer.selectedOverrides#`.

The watermark's normal color is picked to read against the folder's own fill, so on a bright selection it lands far too dark. This pulls it back to just off the selection — present, but with no contrast to fight the label. `selectedOpacity` is accounted for, so the step is measured from what is on screen rather than the configured color.

- `0` — identical to the selection (invisible).
- `0.08` (default) — barely there.
- `0.4+` — an obvious pattern under the selection.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkDimWidth.markdownDescription: The width in px of that clearing on the repo root row. It is baked into the canvas, so resizing the Explorer cannot change how any watermark is drawn.

premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkDimHeight.markdownDescription: The height in px of the clearing on the repo root row — how far apart its points sit down the canvas. Capped at `#premiumExplorer.rootWatermarkCanvas#`, and the shape tapers to a point at top and bottom so it tiles seamlessly.

premiumExplorer.innerWatermarkDimWidth.markdownDescription: The width in px of that clearing on the rows inside a colored folder. It is baked into the canvas, so resizing the Explorer cannot change how any watermark is drawn.

premiumExplorer.innerWatermarkDimHeight.markdownDescription: The height in px of the clearing on the rows inside a colored folder — how far apart its points sit down the canvas. Capped at `#premiumExplorer.innerWatermarkCanvas#`, and the shape tapers to a point at top and bottom so it tiles seamlessly.
